title: Manufacturing preferences and work centers
summary: Set production rules and add the work centers runs are scheduled against.

steps.text: Open {settings} from the gear link on the Manufacturing group to set company-wide rules.
Turn on {require} to block completing a run until its components are issued.
Choose {wc} to add a work center, so runs can be assigned to a working area and its working-day length.
You can also ask the assistant to add, change or remove a work center, or set the default one. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
